scope.case_key: SHA256 of original sample_id, consistent across runs; not a claim of irreversible anonymization
excludes: private human-review packets and blind A/B keys
secrets, arbitrary stdout/stderr and local identity/paths
includes: all retained predictions (model generations), per-case scores, failure statuses
training events and portable configuration/execution/reload metadata
all retained LoRA weights including smoke and selected/latest checkpoints
existing public reports and historical verification receipts
scope.resume_limits: Adapters support model reload. Exact training continuation requires excluded local optimizer/RNG state and separately acquired datasets/base model.
scope.v5_scores: same unchanged score_rows applied independently to each frozen validation cell; no new inference
